description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/ado-open-provider-property: reading Properties on a fresh Connection pinned MSDASQL, so the probe never inventoried ACE and its Open failure was ODBC. A fresh Connection sets Provider = ACE before anything is read; then State, Provider, ConnectionString, Mode, CursorLocation, timeouts, Version, Attributes, IsolationLevel and the full Properties inventory (Name, Type, Value, Attributes); Properties("Data Source") is set to the fixture path through a retained Property wrapper (Value and Attributes read back) and Mode = adModeRead; Open; the same state and inventory, DefaultDatabase, the retained wrapper's Value, Connection.Errors; Close; state, the wrapper, Properties.Count and the inventory once more. Asks which properties exist and what they hold in each state for the ACE provider.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
